changeSet.author: cpn
changeSet.comment: Phần phiếu thu: SENDER hoặc DELIVERY. Null giữ cách trừ cũ (VP gửi trước).
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE receipt_order_line l INNER JOIN receipt r ON r.id = l.receipt_id SET l.portion = 'DELIVERY' WHERE l.portion IS NULL AND r.payer_code IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_payment p WHERE p.order_id = l.order_id AND p.payment_kind = 'SAU' AND p.note LIKE 'POD%' AND LOWER(p.collector_username) = LOWER(r.payer_code) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_payment p WHERE p.order_id = l.order_id AND p.payment_kind = 'TRUOC' AND LOWER(p.collector_username) = LOWER(r.payer_code) );
UPDATE receipt_order_line l INNER JOIN receipt r ON r.id = l.receipt_id SET l.portion = 'SENDER' WHERE l.portion IS NULL AND r.payer_code IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_payment p WHERE p.order_id = l.order_id AND p.payment_kind = 'TRUOC' AND LOWER(p.collector_username) = LOWER(r.payer_code) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_payment p WHERE p.order_id = l.order_id AND p.payment_kind = 'SAU' AND p.note LIKE 'POD%' AND LOWER(p.collector_username) = LOWER(r.payer_code) );
